idea-plugin.name: Tree-lint
idea-plugin.description:
Runs tree-lint scans for the current project and shows project structure violations right inside the IDE.

  • Highlights files and folders that break the structure rules — and every parent folder up to the project root — in the Project view, colored by severity.
  • Tree-lint tool window with the full violation list; double-click opens the file or reveals the folder in the project tree.
  • Automatic mode finds the config, Node.js on PATH, and a locally installed CLI (node_modules/@redwestdev/tree-lint or node_modules/.bin, falling back to a global tree-lint); manual mode lets you set the executable paths and the scan timeout explicitly.
  • Scans on project open, file save, file create/rename/delete and config changes, plus Tools → Tree-lint: Scan Project on demand. Which files are checked is decided by the tree-lint config, not the plugin.

Requirements: Node.js 18+, a tree-lint.config.* in the project, and tree-lint 0.0.6+ with the --report flag.

action.description: Run tree-lint scan for the current project
